Maya H: Quick sync — planning final benchmark visuals for the launch post + webinar. Need decisions on chart axes, primary callouts, and SDR routing for high-intent leads. Thoughts?
Alex G: Love a combined scatter (latency vs $/1k tokens) with model clusters. Suggest log scale for cost (y) and linear for p95 latency (x). Shade an 'acceptable' zone (<=150ms & <= $4/1k). :dart:
Jing W: Agree re: log cost. Also show hosted vs dedicated as different shapes. Annotate 3 workload examples: chatty assistant, embedding batch, reranker. Keep hero chart minimal.
Sam R: @Maya H for SDR routing — proposed quick rule: if a user runs >50k tokens in first 30 days OR signs up with company email + privacy checkbox, route to AE. Otherwise nurture. Draft rule (pseudo):
```
if (tokens_30d > 50000 || enterprise_email) -> tag: 'high-intent' -> route: sdr_queue_a
else -> nurture_sequence
```
Maya H: Perfect. Microcopy note: put small notes on the chart: 'Lower is better' on both axes? Use label "$ per 1k tokens" for cost and clarify p95 latency. Add a tooltip about quantization/throughput tradeoffs.
Priya S: For the webinar slide, start with a 1-line thesis: "Serving economics — latency and unit cost determine product feasibility at scale." Then show two compact case studies: "chat app" and "analytics embedding pipeline" with arrows illustrating tradeoffs.
Alex G: For the blog hero chart avoid clutter — limit to ~6 model points (curated open models + Redwood-verified). Include a secondary appendix slide with the full scatter and raw numbers.
Jing W: I'll mock the hero + appendix in Figma. Timeline: first draft by EOD Wednesday. I need the exact callout copy from marketing to place next to points. :spiral_note_pad:
Maya H: SDR routing followups: @Sam can you post exact filter names and sample outreach templates? We also need lead-scoring field names so infra can tag leads automatically.
Sam R: Will post filters + outreach lines in #sales later today. Example subject: "Bench results look like you — quick chat?" — attach recommended playbook and next-step CTA. :email:
LaunchBot: Deployed: benchmark-visuals-draft uploaded to drive by Jing W — https://drive.company/bench-draft (file: bench_visuals_v1.fig)
Priya S: Draft copy for chart callouts (quick bullets): "p95 latency — perceived snappiness", "Unit cost ($/1k tokens) — marginal infra spend", "Dedicated — predictable throughput, higher baseline", "Hosted — fast to try, variable economics". I'll expand these tomorrow.
Maya H: Final checklist: Alex — approve hero; Jing — Figma draft; Priya — callouts + blog intro; Sam — SDR rules + template. Can we freeze visuals + routing rules by Friday?
Alex G: Yes — freeze by Friday works for me. :thumbsup:
